label: KH Battery Bench
info:
Receives events from KH Battery Bench.

SETUP
1. Deploy this flow.
2. Bench > Setup > Notifications > + Add webhook
   URL: http://<node-red-host>:1880/kh-bench
3. Click "Send test". It should appear in the debug sidebar.

EVENTS (msg.payload.event)
run.started, run.resting, run.passed, run.failed,
run.aborted, bench.all_done, channel.offline, test

msg.payload.text is a ready-to-send one-liner.
msg.payload.run has the full run record (serial, SOC, OCV, cert no...).

WIRE THE OUTPUTS TO
- email node (node-red-node-email)
- MS Teams / Slack / Power Automate (http request node POSTing to their webhook)
- a stack light / andon (MQTT, Modbus, GPIO): red on ALERT, green on all_done
